buffs.title: Spirit Break
buffs.desc:
· Increases Agent Anomaly Buildup Rate by <color=#2BAD00>30%</color> and <color=#FFFFFF>Disorder</color> DMG by <color=#2BAD00>40%</color>.
· When inflicting <color=#FFFFFF>Disorder</color> on an enemy, recovers all squad members' Energy by <color=#FFFFFF>10</color> and increases Agent's ATK by <color=#FFFFFF>25%</color> for 30s. The Energy Generation effect can trigger once every 20s.

buffs.desc: · Agent ATK <color=#2BAD00>increases by 20%</color>, Decibel Generation Rate <color=#2BAD00>increases by 20%</color>. buffs.title: Interrupt
buffs.desc:
· <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Dodge Counter</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color>, and <color=#FFFFFF>Dash Attack</color> DMG increases by <color=#2BAD00>30%</color>.
· After triggering a <color=#FFFFFF>Perfect Dodge</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>Perfect Assist</color>, increases all squad members' ATK by <color=#2BAD00>10%</color> and CRIT DMG by <color=#2BAD00>10%</color> for 15s. Stacks up to 3 times. The duration of each stack is calculated separately.

zoneBuffs.desc: · When inflicting <color=#FFAF2C>an Attribute Anomaly or Disorder</color> on a boss enemy, all squad members gain <color=#FFFFFF>Laser Focus</color>, which stacks up to 6 times. When having at least 3 stacks of <color=#FFFFFF>Laser Focus</color>, inflicting an <color=#FFAF2C>Attribute Anomaly</color> will increase its duration by 5s. · Successfully <color=#FFAF2C>interrupting a chant</color> grants <color=#FFAF2C>2,000 Performance Points</color>. A maximum of 5,000 Performance Points can be obtained.

· The Agent's <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color> and <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color> will <color=#2BAD00>increase by 25%</color>.
· After triggering <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Perfect Assist</color>, or <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Assist</color>, the Agent's CRIT Rate <color=#2BAD00>increases by 20%</color> and CRIT DMG <color=#2BAD00>increases by 40%</color> for 20s.

buffs.title: Anomaly Surge
buffs.desc:
· The Agent's Anomaly Buildup Rate <color=#2BAD00>increases by 10%</color>, and when a shield is active, the Anomaly Buildup Rate <color=#2BAD00>further increases by 20%</color>.
· When attacking enemies in an Attribute Anomaly state, the Agent's DMG <color=#2BAD00>increases by 40%</color>.

zoneBuffs.desc:
· When the Agent <color=#FFAF2C>hits the boss enemy with a Defensive Assist or Chain Attack</color>, they apply 1 stack of <color=#FFFFFF>Weakening</color> to the target, lasting 20s. The duration of each stack is calculated separately. For each stack of <color=#FFFFFF>Weakening</color> on the target, Agent CRIT DMG is <color=#FFAF2C>increased by 15%</color>.

When the boss enemy has 4 stacks of <color=#FFFFFF>Weakening</color>, Defensive Assist will deflect the boss enemy's attack, causing a Stagger effect.
· Successfully <color=#FFAF2C>triggering Perfect Assist</color> grants <color=#FFAF2C>300 Performance Points</color>. A maximum of 5,000 Performance Points can be obtained.

buffs.title: Rapid Aid
buffs.desc:

· Each use of <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Assist</color> increases all squad members' ATK by <color=#2BAD00>10%</color> for 20s, stacking up to 3 times. Repeated triggers reset the duration.

· For Agents, <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color> and <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color> <color=#2BAD00>increase by 30%</color>.
· When inflicting Attribute Anomaly on enemies, for the whole squad, ATK <color=#2BAD00>increases by 8%</color> and Decibel Generation Rate <color=#2BAD00>increases by 8%</color> for 20s, stacking up to 4 times. Repeated triggers reset the duration.

zoneBuffs.desc: · Agents inflict <color=#FFFFFF>Overwhelmed</color> when <color=#FFAF2C>landing a Defensive Assist hit</color> against a Boss enemy, and 3 stacks of <color=#FFFFFF>Overwhelmed</color> when accumulating 3 <color=#FFFFFF>Defensive Assist</color> hits and triggering Impaired. Each stack of <color=#FFFFFF>Overwhelmed</color> increases Daze by <color=#FFAF2C>15%</color>, and <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color> and <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate</color> DMG taken while Stunned by <color=#FFAF2C>10%</color>. The enemy will fix the impaired parts and reset the impairment level while charging, and will reset its <color=#FFFFFF>Overwhelmed</color> stacks after recovering from Stun.
· <color=#FFFFFF>Assist Points</color> are not consumed for this battle.

· Successfully <color=#FFAF2C>triggering a Perfect Assist</color> grants <color=#FFAF2C>200 Performance Points</color>
. Successfully <color=#FFAF2C>causing Impaired</color> grants <color=#FFAF2C>600 Performance Points</color>. A maximum of 5,000 Performance Points can be obtained.

buffs.title: Artful
buffs.desc:
· Agent DMG <color=#2BAD00>increases by 20%</color> and <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color> <color=#2BAD00>increases by an additional 20%</color>.
· After inflicting an Attribute Anomaly on an enemy, the enemy's DEF <color=#2BAD00>decreases by 10%</color> for 10s. After inflicting Disorder on an enemy, the enemy's DEF <color=#2BAD00>further decreases by 25%</color> for 10s. Each effect's duration refreshes individually.

buffs.title: Fiery Assault
buffs.desc:
· When there are 1/2 Agents with Attack specialty in the squad, the whole squad deals 20%/40% <color=#2BAD00>bonus</color> DMG.
· After triggering a critical hit, the Agent's <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color> <color=#2BAD00>increases</color> by 30%; for Agents with Attack specialty, their CRIT DMG <color=#2BAD00>further increases</color> by 40% for 5s. Repeated triggers reset the duration.

buffs.title: Harnessing Change
buffs.desc:
· <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate</color> DMG <color=#2BAD00>increases</color> by 30%. When launching <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate</color>, the Agent's ATK <color=#2BAD00>increases</color> by 15% for 15s. Repeated triggers reset the duration.
· After enemies become Stunned, their Stun DMG Multiplier <color=#2BAD00>increases by 35%</color>.

zoneBuffs.desc:
· When an Agent hits The Defiler with Defensive Assist, the whole squad gains 1 stack of <color=#FFFFFF>Adjudication</color>; when an Agent knocks down The Defiler attacking in mid-air, the whole squad gains 4 stacks of <color=#FFFFFF>Adjudication</color>. Adjudication can stack up to 6 times and lasts for 30 seconds. Repeated triggers reset the duration.
· For each stack of <color=#FFFFFF>Adjudication</color>, the Agent's CRIT DMG <color=#2BAD00>increases by 5%</color>, Physical DMG <color=#2BAD00>increases by 5%</color>, and Electric DMG <color=#2BAD00>increases by 5%</color>.
· The Defiler receives 25% less Attribute Anomaly DMG.

· When an Agent causes <color=#FFAF2C>Impaired status</color>, they gain <color=#FFAF2C>2500 Performance Points</color>; when an Agent <color=#FFAF2C>shoots down The Defiler while it's attacking in mid-air</color>, they gain <color=#FFAF2C>1500 Performance Points</color>, up to a maximum of 5000 Performance Points.
